purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
audit_findings: The physical specimen remains distinct from its source, digital record, accession, label, container, position, repository holding, analysis and result.
The WM-LIV-002 relation is optional because an organism is common but not universal specimen source context.
The WM-LIV-024 repository and WM-MAT-007 analysis relations remain external references and cannot own specimen identity.
Every split, aliquot, pool, extract, culture or transformed output receives new identity and preserves all parent inputs and quantity effects.
Collection, receipt, accession, processing, storage, custody, observation, consumption and correction clocks remain distinct.
Quality, contamination, sufficiency and fitness are method-, time- and purpose-qualified assessments rather than intrinsic truth.
Location, possession, custody, control, ownership and permitted use are not conflated.
Human, biodiversity, environmental and regulated-material profiles retain distinct consent, permit, benefit-sharing, safety and access controls.
Destructive use and disposal require authority, quantity accounting, retention checks and immutable evidence.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
